'''Young Jedi''' is Decipher's 1999 ''Star Wars'' customizable card game based on ''The Phantom Menace''. It is a different game from [[Star Wars CCG]].

The [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] GeoCities site published two Young Jedi lists (Jedi and Sith) next to its Classic Star Wars decks. Those dests are on [[Corellian Engineering Corporation decks]].
